# VisiDocsverse

> VisiDocsverse is an offline-first Windows app that hangs every document
> (PDFs, Word, spreadsheets, slides, notes) in 3D space, where related ideas
> pull together with real gravity. Free 21-day trial, then $4/month billed
> twice a year. Your files never leave your PC. For researchers, writers and
> analysts drowning in PDFs who distrust cloud AI toys.
